note: Placeholder data. These are the five preferences the PRD names plus two obvious companions, encoded so they can be swapped for a consultant's own. Vaastu is not a code, no authority enforces it, and its schools disagree; this file is a starting point and NOT the opinion of a practising Vaastu consultant.

preferences.source: Agni, the fire element, is placed in the south-east
the heaviest corner of the plot carries the principal bedroom
Ishanya, the north-east, is kept for the prayer space
toilets are kept out of the north-east and off the brahmasthan
the public rooms take the lighter northern and eastern sides
secondary bedrooms follow the master away from the north-east
the main entry is taken from the lighter half where the plot allows
